items.title: Andy Anderson Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Colonel Brent was over there then. Colonel Brent, I was passing through there... he saw me at the Trump and said, come here, soldier... He said, I got a song here, saying I want you to play it.

ctx.x: Did you play in any army band or dances band there too?

Yes sir. So I'm coming to that now. So I left, I mean after these fellas, they took me and put me on KP one day, see, in the army, well every now and then I used to blow a tune, see, well they put me on KP. And the major, and then we missed the trumpet, he said, why is that fella playing that trumpet around there? I said, the fella from here, Sergeant Crude, he said, Italian fella. Oh he's on KP. He said, go get that, take that, go get that man. Let that man play that trumpet. So he came and brought another…
I keep interrupting you, but I forgot to ask you something more. When you were growing up, who were some of your favorite trumpet players?
